title: Crashes & hangs
summary: Programs that crash or stop responding.

events.title: An application crashed
events.meaning: A program stopped unexpectedly and Windows closed it. The message names the program and the module that failed.
events.causes: A bug in the program or one of its DLLs, a bad update, or damaged files.
events.next: Note the program and the faulting module. Update or reinstall the program, and check for recent changes.

events.title: An application stopped responding
events.meaning: A program stopped responding and was closed. The message names the program.
events.causes: The program was busy or stuck, waiting on a slow disk or network, or a faulty add-in.
events.next: Note the program. Update it, turn off add-ins, and check disk and network speed.

events.title: Windows saved a crash report
events.meaning: Windows recorded details about a crash or hang, including a bucket ID and the report files.
events.causes: It follows a program crash, hang or blue screen.
events.next: Use it with the crash event just before it to see which program and module were involved.

events.title: A .NET application crashed with an unhandled error
events.meaning: A .NET program hit an error it did not handle and closed. The message includes the exception and stack trace.
events.causes: A bug in the program, a missing file, or a wrong .NET version.
events.next: Read the exception text at the top of the message. Update or reinstall the program, or install the .NET version it needs.
